results.description:
The brand-new novel from the bestselling author of How to Kill Men and Get Away With it.

‘So engaging and easy to get lost in. I couldn’t put it down’ ★★★★★

‘All the twists, all the drama and wit sharp enough to slit throats’ Tam Barnett

* * * * * *

If a man hurt your best friend – like, really hurt her – what would you do?

Key his car? Or hunt him down and chop him into little pieces? Tough decision, I know.

I’ve tracked this lowlife to LA and brought my little sister Antoinette along for the ride. I'm trying not to be irritated that she's found a taste for murder and is leaving body parts all over our hotel. Because this girls’ trip needs a Hollywood ending.

And of all the men I've killed before, this one will be the sweetest…

* * * * * *

Praise for To All the Men I've Killed Before

Featured as 'best books about female rage' in Stylist

‘Kitty Collins is back and as sharp, funny and dangerous as ever and, with the arrival of her sibling sidekick, dare I say, endearingly tender too. When it comes to the patriarchy, Brent is killing it. Brava!’ Amy Beashel

‘Kitty’s finale is well worth the wait. God, we are gonna miss her but this is a killer’ Asia MacKay

‘Sharp in wit and blunt in murder weapon. I had a bloody good time rooting for my fave vegan serial killer as she strutted her gloriously gory way around Hollywood’ Charlotte Vassell

‘Whip smart and deliciously dark’ Kate Gray

'Deliciously dark and irreverent' Delia Online

About the author

KATY BRENT is the author of three novels. Previously an award-winning journalist, she always dreamed of writing a book and lockdown finally gave her the excuse to do it.
